_comment: Curated XRP Ledger watchlist for the on-chain exchange-flow monitor. Every address was verified via the XRPScan account-label API (accountName.username) before inclusion - never add an address from memory. To extend: confirm the label at https://api.xrpscan.com/api/v1/account/<address> (accountName.username), then append {address, label, kind}. kind=exchange wallets feed the net-flow signal; kind=whale wallets are tracked for large-transfer alerts only and are EXCLUDED from exchange net flow.
